narrAffiliate.name: Mental Health and Addiction Certification Board of Oregon (MHACBO)

narrNote: MHACBO appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22) as 'The Mental Health and Addiction Certification Board of Oregon (formerly ACCBO)'. MHACBO accredits Oregon recovery residences to the NARR standard; certification is voluntary in Oregon.
notes: Agency phone is OHA's published main line (503-947-2340, shown on OHA letterhead/contact pages on oregon.gov); the Behavioral Health Division About page does not publish a separate division number. NASADAD's SSA listing names OHA's Health Systems Division; OHA's current structure places these functions in the Behavioral Health Division, whose About page was fetched and verified. 211info is Oregon's statewide 211 (dial 211 or 866-698-6155, per its homepage) and also covers four southwest Washington counties. Lines for Life is Oregon's 988 center and runs the 24/7 Alcohol & Drug Helpline (1-800-923-4357, confirmed on its homepage). The OHP behavioral health page confirms Oregon Health Plan coverage of SUD treatment including MAT, detox, and residential care with no referral required. Every URL in this file was fetched and content-checked on 2026-10-22.
